description: Permissions related to accessing and viewing the main dashboard and its various sections.

permissions.description: Access the main dashboard with operational summaries and activity feeds.
Access the financial section of the dashboard with summaries and key metrics.
Access the staff section of the dashboard with summaries and key metrics.
Access the operations section of the dashboard with summaries and key metrics.

description: Permissions related to managing and viewing project records, statuses, and associated details.

permissions.description: Browse and view project records, statuses, and associated details.
Access financial details for projects including budgets, costs, and profitability.
Access staff details for projects including assignments, roles, and availability.

Access client details for projects including contact information and associated projects. This does NOT prevent the user from seeing who the primary client and primary contact is for a project, even if they don't have this permission. This permission only controls access to the full client details page for the primary client and contact.

Create, edit, and delete projects, as well as manage project assignments and phases. NOTE: If a user has this permission, they will be able to see all project details and financials, even if they don't have the more specific view permissions for those sections.
Allows creating projects directly without going through the proposal process. This is intended for internal use and may bypass certain validations and workflows.
Allows creating projects from approved proposals. This ensures that projects are created with the necessary financial and scope details defined in the proposal.
Edit financial details for projects including budgets, task pricing, and billing status.
Change project status and billing status values.
Create new project records.
Permanently remove project records. Reserved for super administrators by default.
Access projects that have been archived. This allows users to see historical project records that are no longer active.
Allow user to be assigned as a project manager on projects.

description: Permissions related to viewing, creating, updating, and deleting task records within projects.

permissions.description: Browse and view task records within projects.
Access financial details for tasks including price, retainer, hours, and invoice type.
Edit basic task details such as service, manager, and description.
Edit financial fields on tasks including price, retainer, hours, and invoice type.
Change task status and billing status values.
Create new task records within projects.
Archive task records without permanently deleting them.
Search and view archived task records within accessible projects.

description: Permissions related to viewing, creating, updating, merging, and deleting client and contact records.

permissions.description: Browse and view client records and contact information.

Access client records that have been archived. This allows users to see historical client information that is no longer active. This permission does not grant access to archived contacts - that is controlled by the separate 'contacts.view.all' permission.
Update non-status client details such as names, phone numbers, emails, notes, and address information.
Review duplicate client records, merge them into a master record, and soft-close non-master records.
Change client statuses including inactive and do-not-engage states.
Create new client records.
Permanently remove client records. Reserved for super administrators by default.
Browse and view individual contact records linked to clients and projects.
Update non-status contact details such as names, phone numbers, emails, notes, position, and linked address information.
Review duplicate contact records, merge them into a master record, and soft-close non-master records.
Change contact statuses including inactive and do-not-contact states.
Create new contact records.
Permanently remove contact records. Reserved for super administrators by default.
Access contact records that have been archived. This allows users to see historical contact information that is no longer active.
Browse and view vendor records and associated service information.

description: Permissions related to viewing financial records, summaries, and reports.

permissions.description: Review all staff timesheets. Employees can always view their own.
Approve, reject, or reopen timesheets in the reporting chain.
View pay tables, labor costs, charged values, and the invoice pool.
Manage billing positions and pay tables.
Receive the Monday report of missing and pending timesheets.
Access expense records and reimbursement submissions.
Access financial summaries, proposals, invoices, and payment records.
Include the user in financial email notifications.

permissions.displayName: Include User in Sensitive Financial Emails
permissions.description: Include the user in sensitive financial email notifications.
Access generated reports including project, financial, and personnel reports.
View invoice records and details.
Create invoice records.
Update invoice records and status.
Email an invoice after it has been updated.
Send invoice emails to recipients outside the standard billing contacts.

description: Permissions related to managing and viewing user accounts and their details.

permissions.description: See the list of user accounts in the system.
View basic profile details and settings for individual user accounts. Does not include sensitive information.
Access sensitive employee information such as compensation and protected staff records.
Update existing user accounts including roles, providers, and status.
Provision new user accounts in the system.
Send invitations to new users to set up their accounts.
Permanently remove user accounts from the system.

description: Permissions related to managing company profile details, settings, and role management.

permissions.description: Access company profile details, settings, and role management.
Edit company profile details, update settings, and manage roles and permissions.
Access the list of roles and their associated permissions.
Create, edit, and delete roles, as well as assign permissions to roles.
Create new role definitions.
Permanently remove role definitions from the system.
View QuickBooks connection and synchronization status.
Connect and manage the QuickBooks integration.
Retry failed QuickBooks record synchronization.

description: Permissions related to system-level access and administrative tools.

permissions.description: Access internal debug tooling and diagnostics. Reserved for super administrators.
